note: Experiment 133, part A. What really happened to each kamp-us/demlik ticket, read by hand from its closing comment and the merged pull request, before any sort answer was seen. A `fold` ticket was folded by triage into another ticket (`into`) that was still open when this one was filed, and its work landed in that ticket's pull request. Where two targets are right, both are listed: 424 to 426 shipped bundled with #423, which was one stage of the open umbrella #422. A `control` ticket was filed while a related ticket it names (`near`) was open, and got a plan and a merged pull request of its own; that pull request closes no other ticket. Controls are a seeded draw (seed 133) from the 88 demlik tickets that fit, with #430 skipped on the hand read: #422's closing comment counts it as part of #422. `why` is a few words.

424.why: bundled with #423 as lowering pipeline part 2; PR 450

425.why: bundled with #423 as lowering pipeline part 2; PR 450

426.why: bundled with #423 as lowering pipeline part 2; PR 450

444.why: bundled with #412: one tsgo session; PR 446

717.why: folded into #714's PR: same files; PR 718

21.why: folded into #20 weeks after filing, one lane ships both; PR 195

412.why: own PR 446 (it also carried the fold of #444)

468.why: own PR 476 (it also carried the fold of #448)

needsInfoNote: Experiment 133, part B. A seeded draw (seed 133) of 15 from the 51 closed kamp-us/phoenix tickets that ever carried `status:needs-info` (one triage self-test left out), read by hand from triage's comments and what came after, before any sort answer was seen. `end`: built by a merged PR, closed for no answer, closed as not worth doing (`no`), or closed as a duplicate or as covered by an open ticket. `asked`: what the label was waiting on. `answered`: someone gave it. `who`: who held what triage was waiting on: the filer, the code (or the GitHub API: something a scout with read access finds), an owner's ruling on a real question, or an owner's permission only, where triage already knew the answer and a rule (a ticket filed without the agent footer is never closed by triage) kept it from acting. `changed`: the missing fact moved the ticket away from what its own text asks for (a refuted premise turned a fix into a no, or a dup into a fold). `why` is a few words.

1919.why: no defect, no surface in the repo; closed minutes later with no answer
